title: Free ADHD task card maker: print your own chore cards
description: Make your own printable ADHD task card: a few tiny steps and a bad-day version. Print four per page or save it as an image. Free, no signup.
h1: Make your own printable ADHD task card

faq.q: What makes a good ADHD task card?
faq.a: It lives where the task happens, the first step takes under ten seconds, there are no more than five steps, and the last line is a bad-day version small enough to do on your worst day. Write steps as actions you can see, not goals.
Press Print. The page prints four copies of your card on one A4 or letter sheet with dashed borders to cut along. Plain paper works; cardstock lasts longer by the sink.
No. The card is built in your browser. Nothing is uploaded or stored, and it is gone when you close the tab unless you print it or save the image.
